commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: A ruler with these four is a lamp to all rulers: giving people what they need, showing everyone warmth with a bright face and sweet words, doing justice, and caring for people who have fallen on hard times. From such people he takes his sixth share only once their poverty has ended, and gives it up if he must.
